replay: Message arrives claiming to be your bank
You trust it and tap the link

Your account is drained
A message pushes you to install a file
The app gets SMS and screen access
It reads your OTPs silently
Your banking app is controlled and emptied
You are told to scan a QR to receive money
The QR is actually a payment request
You approve under pressure
Money leaves your account
A convincing fake shop or refund page appears
You trust the branding
You pay
The payee is an unrelated account
A message says your package is held
You pay a small fee through the link
Your card details are captured
A larger charge follows
Someone claiming to be an officer or agency contacts you
They say you are in serious trouble and must act now
They tell you to stay quiet and stay on the call
You transfer money to prove your innocence
A stranger says they sent you money by mistake
They pressure you to return it quickly
You send real money from your own account
Their payment is reversed or never existed, and your money is gone
